contributions.name: Cédric Bernadac
contributions.summary: Runs the Z Code game workshop, requested this stickman brawler and directed the desert high-noon art direction.

contributions.name: Z Code
contributions.summary: Designed and implemented the game: brawler engine, five weapons, five boss patterns, procedural stickman animation, WebAudio sound synthesis, trilingual interface (EN/FR/ES), touch controls, and the automated test suite; verified the game in the browser before and after publication.

contributions.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
contributions.summary: Reviewed the combat balance with quantified analysis (damage-per-second curve, hit-count thresholds, sustain, enrage pacing); its adjustments and the "desert counter" perfect-dodge idea were applied by Z Code.
